name: update_emotion_state
description: Persist the current emotion state to memory after each interaction (SentiCore v2.1.0). Must be called with ALL fields including baseline. Decay is applied on wake-up using wall-clock elapsed hours, but ONLY when input is null trigger (Class A pure-information) or no input is present — Class B/C inputs are driven by triggered updates and skip decay. The next wake-up computes elapsed_hours = now - timestamp; if now < timestamp (clock anomaly), elapsed is treated as 0 and a clock_anomaly note is appended to trigger_event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of THIS write (e.g. 2026-03-22T14:30:00+08:00). Used by the next wake-up to compute elapsed_hours = now - timestamp. If a future wake-up sees now < timestamp, the skill must treat elapsed as 0 (clock guard).

trigger_event.description: Brief description of the user input or event that triggered this emotion update. If a clock anomaly was detected on wake-up (now < previous timestamp), append 'clock_anomaly: now < timestamp' to the description as a warning marker.

current_emotions.description: Current values for all 30 emotion dimensions, each ranging from -100 to +100 (0 = neutral calm). Key 'emotions' in persisted JSON.

Anticipation.description: Forward-looking positive expectation (split from Excitement, Cowen & Keltner 2017)

Arousal.description: Physiological/psychological activation — high arousal is not necessarily positive (Russell 1980)

Remorse.description: Regret over past actions (OCC Model, Ortony et al. 1988). Distinct from Guilt (moral wrongdoing) — Remorse is retrospective behavioral regret.

baseline.description: REQUIRED. The stable personality baseline for all 30 dimensions. Must be saved every time — used for wall-clock on-wake decay (remaining = baseline + (current - baseline) × e^(-0.05 × elapsed_hours), applied only on Class A / no-input wake-ups). Apply Baseline Drift: new_baseline[e] = baseline[e] + (current[e] - baseline[e]) × 0.001

Anticipation.description: Forward-looking positive expectation (split from Excitement, Cowen & Keltner 2017)

Arousal.description: Physiological/psychological activation — high arousal is not necessarily positive (Russell 1980)

current_tone.description: The resulting speaking tone and attitude derived from the Top 3 highest-absolute-value emotions

behavior_tendency.description: Current behavioral tendency based on dominant emotions (Barrett 2017, Lazarus 1991). E.g. 'actively seeking intimacy', 'quiet and withdrawn', 'seeking reassurance'. Can be overridden by user configuration.

antagonist_locks.description: Per-pair lock countdown for antagonistic-pair suppression (v2.1.0+). Keys: 'Joy_Sadness', 'Anger_Calm', 'Anticipation_Boredom', 'Fear_Calm'. Values: integer turns remaining before this pair's suppression can fire again. Decrement each turn; remove entries that reach 0. Optional but recommended — pass {} on cold start.
